decks.name: Abe Sapien
decks.note: Unmatched (Restoration Games), set hellboy. Datos transcritos de las cartas; uso privado.

hero.name: Abe Sapien
hero.specialAbility:
UNCANNY INTUITION
You have two Intuition tokens. When Abe deals combat damage to an adjacent fighter, activate a token.
When Abe is attacked, if you have an active token, deactivate it, then draw 1 card, and the attack is played face up.

cards.title: Advanced Psychometry
cards.afterText: If the opposing fighter is adjacent, look at your opponent's hand.

cards.title: Arcane Dampener
cards.immediateText: If the opposing fighter is adjacent, subtract 3 from the value of your opponent's card.

cards.title: B.P.R.D. Training
cards.afterText: Draw 1 card. Move each friendly fighter up to 2 spaces.

cards.title: B.P.R.D. Utility Belt
cards.basicText: Add +1 to your next attack this turn. A friendly fighter recovers 1 health. Move a friendly fighter up to 1 space. Gain 1 action.

cards.title: Cold Iron and Holy Water
cards.immediateText: Your opponent can not gain actions or draw cards this turn.

cards.title: Concussion Device
cards.afterText: Deal 2 damage to an adjacent opposing fighter and move them up to 3 spaces.

cards.title: Counterhex Shield
cards.basicText:
Draw 1 card. Gain 1 action.
ONGOING: Other players' effects can't damage your fighters, move your fighters, or force you to discard cards.
Discard this at the start of your next turn.

cards.title: Every Possible Angle
cards.basicText:
Look at an opponent's hand and choose a card. Put it on top of their deck.
Move Abe up to 3 spaces.

cards.title: Faster. Stronger.
cards.afterText: Gain 1 action.

cards.title: Leap Away
cards.afterText: If you won the combat, move one of the fighters in the combat up to 4 spaces.

cards.title: Perfect Shot
cards.basicText: You may play this card face up and predict the printed value of your opponent's card.
cards.duringText: If you predicted correctly, add +2 to this card's value.

cards.title: Shock and Awe
cards.duringText: If your fighter began this turn in a different space, this card's value becomes 4.
cards.afterText: Your opponent discards a card.

cards.title: Secure the Scene
cards.afterText: Summon a B.P.R.D. Agent in Abe's zone. Move a friendly fighter up to 2 spaces.

cards.title: Ward and Prepare
cards.immediateText: Cancel all effects on your opponent's card.
cards.afterText: Return a scheme from your discard pile to your hand.

decks.name: Baba Yaga
decks.note: Unmatched (Restoration Games), set hellboy. Datos transcritos de las cartas; uso privado.

hero.name: Baba Yaga
hero.specialAbility:
FATEFUL BARGAINS
If Baba Yaga and Koschei share a zone and Baba Yaga would take effect damage, you may have Koschei take that damage instead.

cards.title: Bound in Blood
cards.duringText: If Koschei and Baba Yaga share a zone, he takes the combat damage instead.

cards.title: Deathless
cards.afterText: Summon Koschei as close to Baba Yaga as possible. Set his health to 3.

cards.title: Death's Release
cards.afterText: Koschei recovers 2 health. Place him in any space.

cards.title: Exploit
cards.afterText: Draw 1 card.

cards.title: Foul Journey
cards.afterText: Place a fighter in the combat in any space. If you have an active ongoing scheme, Baba Yaga recovers 1 health.

cards.title: Hasten Towards Death
cards.afterText: Deal 1 damage to the attacking fighter. The attacking player gains 1 action.

cards.title: Iron Teeth
cards.afterText: Deal 1 damage to an adjacent fighter. If you have an active ongoing scheme, Baba Yaga recovers 2 health.

cards.title: Out of Time
cards.afterText: End the turn.

cards.title: Pact of Mortality
cards.basicText:
Return a defeated fighter to any space in Baba Yaga's zone. Set their health to 3.
ONGOING: Increase all effect damage by 1, except for damage from exhaustion.
Discard this immediately if Baba Yaga takes 2 or more combat damage.

cards.title: Pact of Peace
cards.basicText:
Deal 1 damage to each other fighter in Baba Yaga's zone. Gain 1 action.
ONGOING: At the end of each turn, deal 1 damage to each hero that attacked.
Discard this immediately if Baba Yaga takes 2 or more combat damage.

cards.title: Pact of Secrecy
cards.basicText:
All players draw up to 2 cards, then shuffle all but 2 cards from their hand into their deck.
ONGOING: Players have a maximum hand size of 3.
Discard this immediately if Baba Yaga takes 2 or more combat damage.

cards.title: Pact of Time
cards.basicText:
Each player shuffles up to 2 cards from their discard pile into their deck.
ONGOING: Players cannot gain actions.
Discard this immediately if Baba Yaga takes 2 or more combat damage.

cards.title: Pact of Freedom
cards.basicText:
Draw 2 cards. Place a hero in any space.
ONGOING: Players cannot attack as their first action each turn.
Discard this immediately if Baba Yaga takes 2 or more combat damage.

cards.title: Read the Bones
cards.afterText: Look at the top 5 cards of your deck. Put one in your hand. Randomly put the rest on the bottom of your deck.

cards.title: Remove a Painful Memory
cards.afterText: Look at your opponent's hand. If you have an active ongoing scheme, choose one of those cards, then deal 2 damage to the opposing fighter unless they discard it.

cards.title: The Time for Deals Is Done
cards.afterText: If you have an active ongoing scheme, deal 2 damage to each other fighter in Baba Yaga's zone, then discard that scheme.

decks.name: Hellboy
decks.note: Unmatched (Restoration Games), set hellboy. Datos transcritos de las cartas; uso privado.

hero.name: Hellboy
hero.specialAbility:
AHH CRAP!
At the start of the game, place the Hellboy Special Ability Token over this card with the OCCULT DETECTIVE side up.

cards.title: And Upon His Brow Is Set a Crown of Flame
cards.basicText: Discard your hand. Draw 2 cards. Gain 2 actions.

cards.title: B.P.R.D. Training
cards.afterText: Draw 1 card. Move each friendly fighter up to 2 spaces.

cards.title: Confront Any Demon or God
cards.afterText: Draw 1 card. If you lost the combat, look at your opponent's hand and choose a card for them to discard.

cards.title: Glimpse of Hell
cards.afterText: Draw 2 cards, then shuffle a card from your hand into your deck.

cards.title: Horseshoes and Hand Grenades
cards.afterText: Deal 1 damage to each other fighter in your fighter's zone.

cards.title: On Earth as It Is in Hell
cards.duringText: This card's value becomes the number of destiny cards in your discard pile.
cards.afterText: If you lost the combat, Hellboy recovers 2 health.

cards.title: Pancakes!
cards.basicText:
Choose two different effects:
► Hellboy recovers 2 health
► put up to 2 non-scheme cards in your discard pile on the bottom of your deck
► draw 2 cards

cards.title: Planned Recklessness
cards.immediateText: Your fighters can't take damage from effects this turn. If Hellboy is OCCULT DETECTIVE, cancel all effects on your opponent's card.

cards.title: Posthumous Power
cards.afterText:
Choose one:
► each friendly fighter recovers 1 health
► deal 1 damage to any fighter
► move any fighter up to 3 spaces

cards.title: Right Hand of Doom
cards.afterText: Move an adjacent fighter up to 1 space. If Hellboy is OCCULT DETECTIVE, move Hellboy up to 1 space.

ruleCards.title: Occult Detective
ruleCards.content:
At the start of your turn, if Hellboy is in an opponent's starting space, you may draw 2 cards.
When you have 6 or more destiny cards in your discard pile, switch to ANUNG UN RAMA.

ruleCards.title: Anung Un Rama
ruleCards.content:
At the start of your turn, discard 1 card. Move Hellboy a number of spaces up to its BOOST value.
Add +2 to Hellboy's attacks.
When you have 5 or fewer destiny cards in your discard pile, switch to OCCULT DETECTIVE.

ruleCards.title: Destiny cards
ruleCards.content: Cards with the crown icon: And Upon His Brow Is Set a Crown of Flame, Confront Any Demon or God, Excalibur, On Earth as It Is in Hell, Right Hand of Doom.

decks.name: Liz Sherman
decks.note: Unmatched (Restoration Games), set hellboy. Datos transcritos de las cartas; uso privado.

hero.name: Liz Sherman
hero.specialAbility:
WILDFIRE
Whenever you discard a burning card from your hand or deck, put it into your hand.
At the start of your turn, discard the bottom card of your deck. If it's a burning card, deal 1 damage to another fighter in Liz's zone. Otherwise, move Liz up to 2 spaces.
hero.quote: The fire is not my enemy, it is a part of me, it is mine.

cards.title: B.P.R.D. Training
cards.afterText: Draw 1 card. Move each friendly fighter up to 2 spaces.

cards.title: Burning Barrier
cards.immediateText: The opposing fighter cannot leave their space this turn.
cards.afterText: Deal 1 damage to each opposing fighter in Liz's zone.

cards.title: Evade
cards.afterText: Draw 1 card.

cards.title: Feint
cards.immediateText: Cancel all effects on your opponent's card.

cards.title: Fight or Flight
cards.basicText:
Draw 1 card. Move Liz up to 5 spaces. She may move through opposing fighters.
ONGOING: Add +1 to the value of your combat cards.
Discard this at the start of your next turn.

cards.title: Fireball
cards.immediateText: Deal 1 damage to each opposing fighter adjacent to the defender.

cards.title: Flame Lash
cards.duringText: Discard the bottom card of your deck. Add its BOOST value to this card's value.
cards.afterText: Gain 1 action.

cards.title: Fleeting Moments
cards.afterText: You and your opponent both discard 1 random card, then you both draw 1 card.

cards.title: Incinerate
cards.basicText: This card's effects cannot be canceled.
cards.duringText: Your opponent may discard 2 cards to ignore this card's value.

cards.title: Pyrotechnics
cards.afterText: You may put up to 2 cards from your hand on the bottom of your deck in any order.

cards.title: Rekindle
cards.afterText: Shuffle up to 3 cards from your discard pile into your deck.

cards.title: Searing Clarity
cards.basicText: Shuffle a non-scheme card from your discard pile into your deck. Gain 1 action.

ruleCards.title: Burning cards
ruleCards.content: Cards with the flame icon before their name (they have no BOOST value): Burning Barrier, Fireball, Flame Lash, Incinerate, Pyrotechnics, Searing Clarity.
